create_highway_layer: create a Highway layer with a specified input dimension and number of layers
build_highway_forward_pass: build a forward pass through the Highway layer to transform input tensors
reset_highway_parameters: reset the Highway layer parameters with Xavier normal weight init and biased gate
review_highway_class: review the Highway class implementation for gated residual connections and transform projections
test_highway_layer: test the Highway layer forward pass with a PyTorch tensor of matching input dimension
